# zone_domains (Data Source)

Reads the domains on the account, newest registration details included.

The listing is paginated by the API at 100 domains a request, and this follows every page. Filtering happens on zone.eu's side, so a filter costs fewer requests on a large account rather than more.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every domain on the account.
data "zone_domains" "all" {}

# Filtering happens on zone.eu's side, so a filter costs fewer requests on a
# large account rather than more. Note that name_contains is a substring match.
data "zone_domains" "expiring" {
  needs_renewal = true
}

output "expiring_soon" {
  value = [for domain in data.zone_domains.expiring.domains : domain.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `delegated` (Boolean) Keep only domains that are (or are not) delegated to another ZoneID user.
- `name_contains` (String) Keep only domains whose name contains this text. This is a **substring** match, not an exact one: `example` also matches `myexample.com`.
- `needs_renewal` (Boolean) Keep only domains expiring within 30 days.
- `renewable` (Boolean) Keep only domains that can (or cannot) be renewed.

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Attributes List) The domains found, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `auth_key_enabled` (Boolean) Whether this TLD uses a transfer authorisation key.
- `autorenew` (Boolean) Whether zone.eu renews it automatically.
- `delegated` (String) ZoneID user the domain is delegated to, or null.
- `dnssec` (Boolean) Whether the domain is DNSSEC signed.
- `dnssec_supported` (Boolean) Whether the registry supports DNSSEC for this TLD.
- `expired` (Boolean) Whether the registration has lapsed.
- `expires` (String) When the registration expires.
- `has_pending_dnssec` (Boolean) Whether a DNSSEC change is still being applied.
- `has_pending_trade` (Number) Identifier of an in-progress trade, or null.
- `name` (String) Domain name.
- `nameservers_custom` (Boolean) Whether the domain uses nameservers other than zone.eu's.
- `reactivate` (Boolean) Whether an expired domain can still be reactivated.
- `renew_order` (String) Pending renewal order, or null.
- `renewal_notifications` (Boolean) Whether renewal reminders are on.
- `resource_url` (String) API URL of this domain.
